Title: Wider View and Vampire with Blood Counters

Messages.Author: bakija
Messages.Body:
What happens if you have a vampire in your uncontrolled region with blood counters on it, and you remove it from the game by virtue of a Wider View cycling? Do they get removed from the game with the crypt card or do they go back to your pool?

(I suspect it is the former, but it never came up before, just did, and we aren't sure what happens. And I even searched the rules forum for posts on Wider View, and nada).

Messages.Author: Adonai
Messages.Body:
> bakija wrote:
> What happens if you have a vampire in your uncontrolled region with blood counters on it, and you remove it from the game by virtue of a Wider View cycling? Do they get removed from the game with the crypt card or do they go back to your pool?
>
Anything and everything on the uncontrolled crypt card is removed from the game along with it. The counters are lost.

> Wider View
> Master
> [1 Pool]
> Master: trifle.
> Put this card in play. You may use a transfer to move the top card from your crypt to your uncontrolled region and then remove a crypt card in your uncontrolled region from the game. You may use four transfers to burn this card and gain 2 pool.
>

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body:
Rulebook 1.1.2 wrote:
>
> When a card is burned or removed from the game, any counters or other cards on it are burned.
>

Messages.Author: Klaital
Messages.Body: They go away with the vampire since there is no explicit card text saying otherwise.
